data.name: Maeliana
data.gender_notes: Maeliana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Maal, meaning 'mistress, lady', and the Greek prefix ana, meaning 'grace, favour'. In the Bible, Maaliah was a priestess and a prophetess from Jerusalem. The name Maeliana therefore represents the grace and favour of the Lord in a young woman. The name Maeliana carries the meaning “Maiden, young woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Maeliana usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, young woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and favour of God in a young woman.
data.etymology: Maeliana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Maiden, young woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maeliana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: מיליאנה
in_hebrew.meaning: מלכת השמים, שפחה של אלוהים, חסידת ה'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מליאנה מורכב משורשים עבריים ויווניים, ומשמעותו 'מלכת השמים' או 'שפחה של אלוהים'. הוא קשור לנושא של שירות ומסירות לאלוהים, ומעיד על קשר הדוק עם האלוקים. השם נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה ומתאר אישה שפוחדת מאלוהים ומקדישה את חייה לשרתו.

in_greek.name: Μαελιάνα
in_greek.meaning: θυγάτηρ του Θεού, δουλή του Κυρίου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαελιάνα έχει ρίζες στην ελληνική και εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'θυγάτηρ του Θεού' ή 'δουλή του Κυρίου'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την αφοσίωση και την υπακοή στον Θεό. Οι γυναίκες που φέρουν αυτό το όνομα θεωρούνται πιστές και αφοσιωμένες στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Maeliana
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Maeliana ex hebraicis et graecis radicibus oritur, significans 'Serva Dei' vel 'Filia Domini'. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen devotionem et obedientiam Deo designat. Mulieres hoc nomen gerentes fideles et Deo dedicatae habentur.

The name Maeliana conveys a sense of reverence, humility, and spiritual dedication.

His legend has him living in isolation for over 70 years, and he was revered as a saint after his death.

Another Maeliana, also known as Maria Maddalena de' Pazzi, was born in 1566 in Florence, Italy. Maeliana lived in a convent in Florence, and her writings on her experiences have been published and studied by scholars. She is considered a Doctor of the Church and a patron saint of Florence.
